phases.title: Frontend Foundation
phases.description: Establish the Next.js frontend foundation and responsive, accessible UI structure.
phases.stateNote: Completed — Final dev-server and dashboard QA complete for P03 Frontend Foundation. Dev-server timeout cause identified as an existing next dev server already holding the frontend .next dev lock on port 3000 ('Another next dev server is already running'), not a product defect or dependency issue. /project-tracker returns HTTP 200 on the running dev server. Real-browser QA passed: desktop layout (16 tasks, no horizontal overflow), mobile layout (390x844 viewport, no overflow), light theme bg rgb(248,249,255), dark theme bg rgb(9,11,20), phase/status/priority filters update task lists correctly (P03→1 task; Completed→P00,P02; High→6 tasks), task details expand showing execution history and verification evidence, zero console errors. Minimal fixes applied: restored root-layout inline theme script in <head> (Next.js dev warning resolved), unique keys for verification list items, UTC date formatting to prevent hydration mismatch.

phases.title: Complete Frontend with Mock Data
phases.description: Complete the frontend preview and interactions without implying a connected model service.
phases.stateNote: Completed — P04 tracker data/update, route, malformed-data and browser QA complete. Tracker data updates verified via documented update script: start/finish records appear in activity log and execution history; next task/recommendation updated on the live dashboard. Malformed or missing progress.json still fails safely - route returns HTTP 200 with a safe unavailable UI instead of crashing or exposing records. Real-browser QA passed (desktop layout, mobile layout, light/dark themes, phase/status/priority filters, task details with execution history and evidence, zero console errors). No authentication, GitHub sync, backend, database, API, or ML implemented; no records exposed publicly; nothing deployed.
